overview: You wrote the last sentence, that she sees him and he is singing so they will not think him afraid. You set the pen down at the foot of the leaf. You did not turn the pile.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page from the workmen through to the queen

important_dates.meaning: Wrote the last sentence and set the pen down
